WHERE d.identifier = $disease_id

WHERE d.identifier = $disease_id
RETURN count(g) AS gene_count

MATCH (d:Disease)-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene)
WHERE d.identifier = $disease_id
RETURN collect(g.identifier) AS gene_ids

MATCH (d:Disease)-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene)
WHERE d.identifier = $disease_id
RETURN count(g) AS gene_count

MATCH (d:Disease)-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene)
WHERE d.identifier = $disease_id
RETURN collect(g.identifier) AS gene_ids

MATCH (d1:Disease)-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]-(d2:Disease)
WHERE d1.identifier = $disease1_id AND d2.identifier = $disease2_id
RETURN count(g) AS shared_count

MATCH (d1:Disease)-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]->(g:Gene)<-[:ASSOCIATES_DaG]-(d2:Disease)
WHERE d1.identifier = $disease1_id AND d2.identifier = $disease2_id
RETURN g.identifier AS gene_id, g.name AS gene_name
ORDER BY g.name
